text:
Ivy (Design): posted a tiny prototype for compact policy rows — goal: keep density but restore visual hierarchy for reordering + validation. quick eyes?
Tom (PM): looks promising. main ask: when sim runs, can we show which rule matched and why in-context? support needs that for repros.
Ivy (Design): plan: a transient inline callout anchored to the rule row: 'Matched: Block - large files — file size > 50MB'. disappears after 3s.
Rae (Frontend): doable. prefer it be in-DOM so scrolling stays consistent. add a 4px left accent on the active row. small CSS: `.rule--active{box-shadow:inset 4px 0 var(--accent);transition:box-shadow .2s}`
Omar (Eng): backend can return rule_name + short_reason (max 140 chars) with the sim payload. will add a cap.
Eve (A11y): a11y notes: callout must be announced via role=status with aria-atomic=true. SR text should be full sentence: "Preview: rule 'Block - large files' matched because file size exceeded 50 MB."
Ivy (Design): good catch. also: reorder handle is too subtle in compact. suggestion: always show a 16px grab icon in compact + larger (44x44) hit area for touch.
Rae (Frontend): will add visible handle + bigger hit target. keyboard label: `aria-label="Drag to reorder"`. when moved, we'll announce: "Rule 'Allow - billing' moved from position three to position one."
Tom (PM): microcopy: change global toast copy to inline badge: "Conflict with 'Allow - billing'" and CTA "Show conflict details" — clearer in tickets.
Omar (Eng): implementation note: debounce server updates and only persist after drop. frontend optimistic update + small inline spinner while commit in-flight.
ux-bot: Created issue: product/rules-ux#4192 — "compact rows: reorder affordance, sim callouts, a11y announcements"
Ivy (Design): thanks all — I'll update the mock to use #004EA8 for contrast and post images. can we quick-review tomorrow 9am?
Tom (PM): yep, scheduled. :thumbsup:
